title: SkyyRose V2 whole-site redesign — Veritas composition × SkyyRose identity

scope.target_environment: local fixture (tools/v2-theme-preview.php) → PR → staging-7e48-skyyrose.wpcomstaging.com (conditional, pre-approved once fixed+verified)
exclusions: PR970 package fb1220db… and archive 37f0d6f7… must not deploy

acceptance_criteria: Every route renders at 1440 and 390 with one dominant focal point per view, full-bleed imagery as structure, restrained navigation, garment as protagonist
Header carries no mascot; Skyy walks onto the screen as a full-body character and is the chat entry (Ask Skyy) on all non-checkout routes; dismiss/recall/pause/reduced-motion/keyboard preserved
Natural-motion GLB tiers (desktop 9b405468…, mobile 72671339…) are the served rig; old rig not deleted without founder y
All existing controllers keep their DOM hooks (visual-recovery, theme.js, scene motion, quick view, bag, search, mascot)
npm run build → check:assets → verify → lint:php → phpcs → package:theme all pass in this session; critical CSS ≤ 16384 bytes
Version triple + CHANGELOG bumped; build-inputs.json input_hashes reconciled; package-boundary.json matches the tree
Independent red-team (Workflow/ultracode, founder-directed) finds no unresolved material defect; every finding first-seen logged here
PR supersedes draft PR970; pr-green-loop drives checks green; merge only on fresh green checks
evidence_requirements: 1440 and 390 fullPage captures per route under tasks/v2-whole-site-rework-20260922/evidence/<surface>/
reduced-motion + no-JS fallback proof for hero video, film band, mascot
console/network trace per route (0 page errors, 0 failed theme requests)
keyboard/focus trace: header menu, search, bag, quick view, mascot dock/dialog, variation form, checkout form
commerce journey proof in fixture: card → PDP → variation → add to bag → cart → checkout form validation
runtime tests: npm run verify output
Lighthouse lab run per key route (fixture) recorded separately from any staging field measurement
